Notes: First Jewish residents: two families of innkeepers who left shortly after; permanent community began early 19th century
Land acquired for Jewish cemetery in 1839 (presence of organized community)
Independent Jewish community authorized in 1864 (previously part of Piotrkow community); it also included Jews of seven surrounding villages; cemetery consecrated
Jewish cemetery established 1864 at Podole Street; destroyed in WWII

About 600 Jewish families on 1 Sept 1939 (~3000 by x5 but source figure for community not converted; may include surrounding area); synagogue burned in Sept 1939 bombardment; 80 of 93 Jewish-inhabited houses destroyed
Population in June 1940 (Pinkas gives range 1150 June 1940 to 1577 July 1942)
Community liquidated October 1942: about 1500 Jews expelled to Piotrkow ghetto then deported to Treblinka 14-21 Oct 1942 (deportation count)
Ghetto established October 1939 for Jews of the town and surroundings holding about 1500 Jews (regional; Polish Wikipedia); deported Oct 1942 to Piotrkow then Treblinka
